merchants.productDescription: As an independent massage therapist, I run my own private practice where every session is tailored to what your body needs that day — whether that's deep tissue work for chronic tension, a restorative Swedish session to unwind, or focused therapeutic work on a problem area. Because I'm independent, you always work directly with me: I handle your booking, your session, and your aftercare recommendations personally, with no front desk or middleman in between. Sessions are available in [30 / 60 / 90]-minute lengths at [$ rates], booked by [text / DM / booking link], and a [deposit amount or 'no deposit'] is required to hold your appointment, with [cancellation policy, e.g., '24 hours' notice to reschedule without a fee']. Payment is simple and due at the time of your session: I accept [e.g., cash, card, Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, Apple Pay], and for card payments I use [Square / my payment app], so you'll get a digital receipt right away. Tips are never expected but always appreciated, and repeat clients can prepay for [package/session bundles] to save on regular visits.
